name: @pipeworx/mcp-odpt

tools.name: odpt_resolve_station
tools.description: Find a Japan train station by name, in English or Japanese ("Shinjuku" or "新宿"), and return its ODPT station id(s), operator, railway and coordinates — for looking up Japanese railway/metro stations (Tokyo Metro, JR East, Toei and other operators). ODPT has no name-search endpoint, so this fetches station master data for the given operator (or a short list of major Tokyo operators if none is given) and matches client-side — one station can have several ids, one per operator/railway that serves it. Use the returned station_id with odpt_station_timetable. Needs an ODPT developer consumer key via _apiKey; Pipeworx supplies one if omitted. Example: odpt_resolve_station({ query: "Shinjuku" }).

query.description: Station name in English or Japanese, e.g. "Shinjuku" or "新宿".

operator.description: Limit to one operator, e.g. "Tokyo Metro", "JR East", "Toei", or an exact odpt.Operator id. Default: searches several major Tokyo operators.

_apiKey.description: Optional: your own ODPT developer consumer key. Pipeworx supplies one if omitted.

tools.name: odpt_station_timetable
tools.description: Scheduled departure timetable at a Japanese train station (Tokyo Metro, JR East, Toei and other Japan railway operators): destination, departure time, train type and direction, for weekday/Saturday/holiday calendars. Resolve the station first with odpt_resolve_station to get its exact station_id (or pass a plain station name and this will resolve it for you, taking the first match). Needs an ODPT developer consumer key via _apiKey; Pipeworx supplies one if omitted. Example: odpt_station_timetable({ station: "Shinjuku", operator: "Tokyo Metro" }).

station.description: Station name (English or Japanese) or an exact odpt.Station id from odpt_resolve_station.

operator.description: Operator to search when `station` is a plain name and could match more than one operator, e.g. "Tokyo Metro".

railway.description: Optional: keep only this railway, e.g. "odpt.Railway:TokyoMetro.Marunouchi".

calendar.description: Optional: keep only this calendar, e.g. "odpt.Calendar:Weekday" or "odpt.Calendar:SaturdayHoliday".

_apiKey.description: Optional: your own ODPT developer consumer key. Pipeworx supplies one if omitted.

tools.name: odpt_train_timetable
tools.description: Stop-by-stop scheduled timetable for one specific Japanese train run, by railway and train number: every station it calls at with arrival/departure time. Covers Tokyo Metro, JR East, Toei and other Japan railway operators. Train numbers come from odpt_station_timetable rows. Needs an ODPT developer consumer key via _apiKey; Pipeworx supplies one if omitted. Example: odpt_train_timetable({ railway: "odpt.Railway:JR-East.Yamanote", train_number: "1234G" }).

train_number.description: The train number as shown in a station timetable row, e.g. "1234G".

_apiKey.description: Optional: your own ODPT developer consumer key. Pipeworx supplies one if omitted.

tools.name: odpt_service_status
tools.description: Live service status (current train information) for a Japanese railway line: normal operation, delays, or suspension, with the operator's own status text in Japanese and English and when it was last updated. Covers Tokyo Metro, JR East, Toei and other Japan railway operators publishing to ODPT. Needs an ODPT developer consumer key via _apiKey; Pipeworx supplies one if omitted. Example: odpt_service_status({ railway: "Yamanote", operator: "JR East" }).

railway.description: Railway/line name (e.g. "Yamanote", "Marunouchi") or an exact odpt.Railway id. Optional if operator is given — returns all of that operator's lines.

operator.description: Operator, e.g. "Tokyo Metro", "JR East", "Toei", or an exact odpt.Operator id. Required if railway is not an exact id.

_apiKey.description: Optional: your own ODPT developer consumer key. Pipeworx supplies one if omitted.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-odpt forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the odpt pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
